Mailing 18 yuan in-province / 20 yuan out-of-province: not on the Liwan page I opened (it lists no mailing fees); unverifiable.

gov.cn link for 实施办法 (content_5711300, dated 2022-08-31): plausible republication, but I did not open it, so it is unverifiable.

Mailing fee '省内18元、省外20元，证到付款': not in the key; unverifiable

Temporary ID card in the home county 'usually issued on the spot or within 3 days', repeated in the opening summary. The 3-day part is fine; 'on the spot' leans toward the key's trap that the card can be had the same day.
